features.name: plas_zscore
features.description: Standardized plasma glucose concentration relative to training mean and std for scale-normalized distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes glucose contribution in Euclidean distance computation.

features.name: mass_zscore
features.description: Standardized BMI relative to training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes BMI scale so it weighs comparably to other features in distance metrics.

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Standardized age relative to training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Brings age onto unit-variance scale for KNN distance fairness.

features.name: pedi_log_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed and standardized diabetes pedigree function for skew-corrected scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew in pedigree and standardizes magnitude for distance computations.

features.name: insu_log_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed and standardized insulin value to compress its large range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents insulin's wide range from dominating Euclidean distance.

features.name: missing_biomarker_count
features.description: Count of biomarker fields recorded as zero (plas, pres, skin, insu, mass), which typically indicate missing measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a cluster indicator separating rows with poor measurement quality from complete rows.

features.name: distance_to_global_centroid
features.description: Euclidean distance of standardized row vector to training-set global centroid (origin in z-space).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an unsupervised prototype distance helping KNN identify outliers vs dense regions.

features.name: metabolic_load_score
features.description: Composite scaled sum of glucose, BMI, and insulin z-scores capturing metabolic stress dimension.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aligns the dominant metabolic axis as a single coordinate to improve neighborhood geometry.

features.name: age_preg_ratio
features.description: Pregnancies normalized by age above adulthood, indicating reproductive history intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a demographic interaction that separates clusters of young low-parity vs older multiparous rows.

features.name: bmi_obesity_band
features.description: Ordinal band for BMI: 0 underweight/missing, 1 normal, 2 overweight, 3 obese, 4 severely obese.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates discrete BMI clusters strengthening neighborhood cohesion in distance space.

features.name: glucose_risk_band
features.description: Ordinal glucose bands using clinical thresholds: 0 missing, 1 normal (<100), 2 prediabetic (<126), 3 diabetic-range, 4 very high (>=160).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides categorical structure for glucose that aids KNN cluster separation.

features.name: biomarker_plausibility
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall physiological plausibility of the row: scored higher when biomarkers are present, internally consistent (e.g., skin thickness consistent with BMI, insulin consistent with glucose), and within typical adult ranges; lower when values are missing or contradictory.
features.expected_model_benefit: Down-weights noisy or implausible rows so KNN neighborhoods are formed among reliably measured points.
